suite_digest_method: SHA-256 of the lexically sorted 30 per-case corpus digests recorded in the detailed JSONL output.
notes: Both configurations use the same local model, 30 human-reviewed cases, and three repetitions. The direct arm receives every case document; Instant Boost retrieves a bounded subset and validates the result.
The Instant Boost repair rate is deterministic citation normalization. It did not add a model call: both configurations averaged one model call per run.
The detailed JSONL output is retained with the run artifacts; this tracked summary is the reviewable publication record.
This is one development run on one model and host. It is not an iPhone performance, energy, thermal, or general-model claim.
